name: Indiana

jury_list.holder: Jury administrator / clerk (IC 33-28-5). The master list of names is public; 'all other information other than the names contained in the master list is confidential' (IC 33-28-5-13(d)).
jury_list.official_pipeline: IC 3-7-38.2-16: each even-numbered year the NVRA official requests from the two federal district courts the names of persons disqualified from jury service for citizenship; the state sends them to county voter registration offices within 28 days after the primary; counties act within 42 days (address confirmation or IC 3-7-38.2-7.3). No state-court jury pipeline was found.

sources.cite: IC 3-7-38.2-16 (federal court jury citizenship data to counties)
IC 33-28-5 (jury selection; master list names public, other information confidential)

voter_file.who_may_get: Full list only to listed entities (parties, independent candidates on the ballot, media for publication, courts for jury systems, legislative leaders) (IC 3-7-26.4-6). Any other person gets a redacted compilation after signing an agreement (IC 3-7-26.4-8, -9).
voter_file.permitted_uses: The agreement bars using the list to solicit sales, and bars selling, loaning, giving away or delivering it to another person for a purpose other than political activities or political fundraising (IC 3-7-26.4-10).
voter_file.attestation_required: Agreement on the Election Division form (IC 3-7-26.4-9, -10): no commercial solicitation; no sale, loan, gift or delivery to another person except for political activities or political fundraising.

private_challenge.who: At the polls only: challengers and precinct election board members may challenge a voter on the challenge affidavit (IC 3-11-8). No pre-election written challenge by a private voter was found in IC 3-7.
private_challenge.form_or_statute: IC 3-11-8 (challenge at the polls). Not supported by JuryRoll.

county_board.name: Indiana Voters - find your county election administrator

gates.basis: Jury qualification information other than names is confidential (IC 33-28-5-13(d)); the status of non-citizen excusal records is not confirmed (null). No private pre-election challenge was found. Strict gates: counts only.

notes: A private requester gets a voter list without date of birth or registration date (IC 3-7-26.4-8). Matching is capped below the full-DOB tier and the registration-date check (LOGIC-CHANGES.md B) cannot run, so every match is excluded by default under B.2 'missing'.
no_online_posting is true because the required agreement bars delivering the list to any other person except for political activities (IC 3-7-26.4-10).
The official pipeline covers federal court jury data only (IC 3-7-38.2-16).
